meta.title: Wicked Intellect
meta.description: All that remains of my former friend is an icy darkness as deep as the abyss.

units.rawText: Inside the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: Inside the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: Inside the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: Kyaak—
units.displayText: Kyaak—

spans.text: Kyaak—

units.rawText: I had expected Entropic presence here, but this number is absolutely insane!
units.displayText: I had expected Entropic presence here, but this number is absolutely insane!

spans.text: I had expected Entropic presence here, but this number is absolutely insane!

units.rawText: Dammit! We don't have any time to waste here!
units.displayText: Dammit! We don't have any time to waste here!

spans.text: Dammit! We don't have any time to waste here!

units.rawText: You two, keep your heads down!
units.displayText: You two, keep your heads down!

spans.text: You two, keep your heads down!

units.rawText: A rain of arrows descends along with her words, eliminating the entirety of the Entropic blockade.
units.displayText: A rain of arrows descends along with her words, eliminating the entirety of the Entropic blockade.

spans.text: A rain of arrows descends along with her words, eliminating the entirety of the Entropic blockade.

units.rawText: That was a bit closer to us that I would have liked... Did you do that on purpose?
units.displayText: That was a bit closer to us that I would have liked... Did you do that on purpose?

spans.text: That was a bit closer to us that I would have liked... Did you do that on purpose?

units.rawText: Hm... I wonder as well.
units.displayText: Hm... I wonder as well.

spans.text: Hm... I wonder as well.

units.rawText: ...Never mind. By the way, that was one hell of an attack...
units.displayText: ...Never mind. By the way, that was one hell of an attack...

spans.text: ...Never mind. By the way, that was one hell of an attack...

units.rawText: You never revealed your true abilities back at Enigma, did you?
units.displayText: You never revealed your true abilities back at Enigma, did you?

spans.text: You never revealed your true abilities back at Enigma, did you?

units.rawText: Wouldn't you like to know?
units.displayText: Wouldn't you like to know?

spans.text: Wouldn't you like to know?

units.rawText: Oh, pay no mind to such things.
units.displayText: Oh, pay no mind to such things.

spans.text: Oh, pay no mind to such things.

units.rawText: Antonina can only take a deep breath and settle her emotions, refocusing upon the screen in front of her.
units.displayText: Antonina can only take a deep breath and settle her emotions, refocusing upon the screen in front of her.

spans.text: Antonina can only take a deep breath and settle her emotions, refocusing upon the screen in front of her.

units.rawText: Are you perhaps troubled by something, Miss Antonina?
units.displayText: Are you perhaps troubled by something, Miss Antonina?

spans.text: Are you perhaps troubled by something, Miss Antonina?

units.rawText: No, just exclaiming that it was prudent to be on your side.
units.displayText: No, just exclaiming that it was prudent to be on your side.

spans.text: No, just exclaiming that it was prudent to be on your side.

units.rawText: I will redistribute our operands according to your displayed capabilities. We need to prepare a contingency plan in the case an emergency arises.
units.displayText: I will redistribute our operands according to your displayed capabilities. We need to prepare a contingency plan in the case an emergency arises.

spans.text: I will redistribute our operands according to your displayed capabilities. We need to prepare a contingency plan in the case an emergency arises.

units.rawText: You certainly seem the reliable sort, Miss Antonina.
units.displayText: You certainly seem the reliable sort, Miss Antonina.

spans.text: You certainly seem the reliable sort, Miss Antonina.

units.rawText: That I am, so please don't speak to me in that tone you reserve for juvenile Agents...
units.displayText: That I am, so please don't speak to me in that tone you reserve for juvenile Agents...

spans.text: That I am, so please don't speak to me in that tone you reserve for juvenile Agents...

units.rawText: ...Never mind, I should save my breath. Plenty of things that'll use up our energy to come.
units.displayText: ...Never mind, I should save my breath. Plenty of things that'll use up our energy to come.

spans.text: ...Never mind, I should save my breath. Plenty of things that'll use up our energy to come.

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll looks towards the upper tower. A thin, seemingly infinite stairway spirals upwards, occupied by countless Entropics lying in wait.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll looks towards the upper tower. A thin, seemingly infinite stairway spirals upwards, occupied by countless Entropics lying in wait.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll looks towards the upper tower. A thin, seemingly infinite stairway spirals upwards, occupied by countless Entropics lying in wait.

units.rawText: ...With this many of them, even with you here to open the way, we'd use up far too much time and operands.
units.displayText: ...With this many of them, even with you here to open the way, we'd use up far too much time and operands.

spans.text: ...With this many of them, even with you here to open the way, we'd use up far too much time and operands.

units.rawText: Our destination is the Pantheon, right? Is there a more... covert and expeditious route?
units.displayText: Our destination is the Pantheon, right? Is there a more... covert and expeditious route?

spans.text: Our destination is the Pantheon, right? Is there a more... covert and expeditious route?

units.rawText: Regrettably, this is the only route. Without these Entropics in the way, I could simply fly us there, but an Entropic attack could come from anywhere with the current state of things...
units.displayText: Regrettably, this is the only route. Without these Entropics in the way, I could simply fly us there, but an Entropic attack could come from anywhere with the current state of things...

spans.text: Regrettably, this is the only route. Without these Entropics in the way, I could simply fly us there, but an Entropic attack could come from anywhere with the current state of things...

units.rawText: Yes, it would be better to move covertly and avoid too much attention.
units.displayText: Yes, it would be better to move covertly and avoid too much attention.

spans.text: Yes, it would be better to move covertly and avoid too much attention.

units.rawText: Hmph, with such a big tower, if I was the place's architect, I would've left some shortcuts for sure...
units.displayText: Hmph, with such a big tower, if I was the place's architect, I would've left some shortcuts for sure...

spans.text: Hmph, with such a big tower, if I was the place's architect, I would've left some shortcuts for sure...

units.rawText: Amidst her ponderings, Antonina pulls up the tower's layout yet again, projecting it into the air.
units.displayText: Amidst her ponderings, Antonina pulls up the tower's layout yet again, projecting it into the air.

spans.text: Amidst her ponderings, Antonina pulls up the tower's layout yet again, projecting it into the air.

units.rawText: What's on your mind, Antonina?
units.displayText: What's on your mind, Antonina?

spans.text: What's on your mind, Antonina?

units.rawText: Just a little concern of mine.
units.displayText: Just a little concern of mine.

spans.text: Just a little concern of mine.

units.rawText: Angelus, what do you know of this area's architecture?
units.displayText: Angelus, what do you know of this area's architecture?

spans.text: Angelus, what do you know of this area's architecture?

units.rawText: Here? As far as I know, this is the Lesser Sanctifiers' rest area.
units.displayText: Here? As far as I know, this is the Lesser Sanctifiers' rest area.

spans.text: Here? As far as I know, this is the Lesser Sanctifiers' rest area.

units.rawText: Give me a moment.
units.displayText: Give me a moment.

spans.text: Give me a moment.

units.rawText: Angelus nods lightly, taking note of Antonina's actions as she fights back the surrounding Entropics. The emerald-haired Doll's fingers tap away and the word "UNLOCKED" soon appears on her screen.
units.displayText: Angelus nods lightly, taking note of Antonina's actions as she fights back the surrounding Entropics. The emerald-haired Doll's fingers tap away and the word "UNLOCKED" soon appears on her screen.

spans.text: Angelus nods lightly, taking note of Antonina's actions as she fights back the surrounding Entropics. The emerald-haired Doll's fingers tap away and the word "UNLOCKED" soon appears on her screen.

units.rawText: The wall she just gestured at opens and a narrow, hidden space can be seen within.
units.displayText: The wall she just gestured at opens and a narrow, hidden space can be seen within.

spans.text: The wall she just gestured at opens and a narrow, hidden space can be seen within.

units.rawText: This is a... hidden path?
units.displayText: This is a... hidden path?

spans.text: This is a... hidden path?

units.rawText: Ah, of course that's what it was...
units.displayText: Ah, of course that's what it was...

spans.text: Ah, of course that's what it was...

units.rawText: ...Mind explaining, Miss Antonina?
units.displayText: ...Mind explaining, Miss Antonina?

spans.text: ...Mind explaining, Miss Antonina?

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier wears a sunny smile upon her face, but something sinister is obvious in her tone.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier wears a sunny smile upon her face, but something sinister is obvious in her tone.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier wears a sunny smile upon her face, but something sinister is obvious in her tone.

units.rawText: How did you come to know of something even I, a Greater Sanctifier, was not aware of?
units.displayText: How did you come to know of something even I, a Greater Sanctifier, was not aware of?

spans.text: How did you come to know of something even I, a Greater Sanctifier, was not aware of?

units.rawText: I just wanted to try something, never expected it to actually work.
units.displayText: I just wanted to try something, never expected it to actually work.

spans.text: I just wanted to try something, never expected it to actually work.

units.rawText: It's just intuition, rather. Ever since we entered this Tower, a familiar feeling has been on my mind.
units.displayText: It's just intuition, rather. Ever since we entered this Tower, a familiar feeling has been on my mind.

spans.text: It's just intuition, rather. Ever since we entered this Tower, a familiar feeling has been on my mind.

units.rawText: Many of the structures here are oddly similar with my way of doing things, similar to an unbelievable degree.
units.displayText: Many of the structures here are oddly similar with my way of doing things, similar to an unbelievable degree.

spans.text: Many of the structures here are oddly similar with my way of doing things, similar to an unbelievable degree.

units.rawText: So I had a look for some shortcuts in accordance with my habits... and my guesswork has been proven correct.
units.displayText: So I had a look for some shortcuts in accordance with my habits... and my guesswork has been proven correct.

spans.text: So I had a look for some shortcuts in accordance with my habits... and my guesswork has been proven correct.

units.rawText: Is that all you have for me?
units.displayText: Is that all you have for me?

spans.text: Is that all you have for me?

units.rawText: I have no need to hide anything... Very well, if you really want, I can show you some "proof".
units.displayText: I have no need to hide anything... Very well, if you really want, I can show you some "proof".

spans.text: I have no need to hide anything... Very well, if you really want, I can show you some "proof".

units.rawText: Antonina displays two blocks of code.
units.displayText: Antonina displays two blocks of code.

spans.text: Antonina displays two blocks of code.

units.rawText: On the left here is a code sample of the Tower you provided and on the right is some Oasis firewall code I wrote.
units.displayText: On the left here is a code sample of the Tower you provided and on the right is some Oasis firewall code I wrote.

spans.text: On the left here is a code sample of the Tower you provided and on the right is some Oasis firewall code I wrote.

units.rawText: Observe this part here... quite similar, right?
units.displayText: Observe this part here... quite similar, right?

spans.text: Observe this part here... quite similar, right?

units.rawText: When you put it that way...
units.displayText: When you put it that way...

spans.text: When you put it that way...

units.rawText: The decisive piece of proof is this comment here on the code in this corner... This is a habit only I have. You'll not find it anywhere else.
units.displayText: The decisive piece of proof is this comment here on the code in this corner... This is a habit only I have. You'll not find it anywhere else.

spans.text: The decisive piece of proof is this comment here on the code in this corner... This is a habit only I have. You'll not find it anywhere else.

units.rawText: You mean to say that the Reverse Babylon Tower is a creation of yours as well?
units.displayText: You mean to say that the Reverse Babylon Tower is a creation of yours as well?

spans.text: You mean to say that the Reverse Babylon Tower is a creation of yours as well?

units.rawText: Angelus subconsciously grips her weapon tightly.
units.displayText: Angelus subconsciously grips her weapon tightly.

spans.text: Angelus subconsciously grips her weapon tightly.

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower is a work of God, descended from above. Are you their servant? Or...
units.displayText: The Reverse Babylon Tower is a work of God, descended from above. Are you their servant? Or...

spans.text: The Reverse Babylon Tower is a work of God, descended from above. Are you their servant? Or...

units.rawText: Your way of treating humanity as deities really is off-putting. I'm just a network safety engineer.
units.displayText: Your way of treating humanity as deities really is off-putting. I'm just a network safety engineer.

spans.text: Your way of treating humanity as deities really is off-putting. I'm just a network safety engineer.

units.rawText: I fear that the entire Reverse Babylon Tower has marks of my handiwork, as you have just witnessed.
units.displayText: I fear that the entire Reverse Babylon Tower has marks of my handiwork, as you have just witnessed.

spans.text: I fear that the entire Reverse Babylon Tower has marks of my handiwork, as you have just witnessed.

units.rawText: ...Why did you not tell us this before?
units.displayText: ...Why did you not tell us this before?

spans.text: ...Why did you not tell us this before?

units.rawText: I only came to realize this just now.
units.displayText: I only came to realize this just now.

spans.text: I only came to realize this just now.

units.rawText: Antonina shakes her head, continuing to explain.
units.displayText: Antonina shakes her head, continuing to explain.

spans.text: Antonina shakes her head, continuing to explain.

units.rawText: In reality, I once performed part of the cloud's network safety design and worked on Magrasea for a period.
units.displayText: In reality, I once performed part of the cloud's network safety design and worked on Magrasea for a period.

spans.text: In reality, I once performed part of the cloud's network safety design and worked on Magrasea for a period.

units.rawText: But out of the project's requirements for secrecy, the relevant memory data was all sealed at the project's end and can't be accessed via normal methods.
units.displayText: But out of the project's requirements for secrecy, the relevant memory data was all sealed at the project's end and can't be accessed via normal methods.

spans.text: But out of the project's requirements for secrecy, the relevant memory data was all sealed at the project's end and can't be accessed via normal methods.

units.rawText: It would appear now that the work back then was related to the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: It would appear now that the work back then was related to the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: It would appear now that the work back then was related to the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier's grip on her bow loosens and she retracts some of her seeping operands.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier's grip on her bow loosens and she retracts some of her seeping operands.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier's grip on her bow loosens and she retracts some of her seeping operands.

units.rawText: I will choose to believe you, Antonina. I will seek out the details from you after things are at an end.
units.displayText: I will choose to believe you, Antonina. I will seek out the details from you after things are at an end.

spans.text: I will choose to believe you, Antonina. I will seek out the details from you after things are at an end.

units.rawText: We have more important matters at hand. We are still some distance away from the Pantheon. Do not let your guard down, Professor.
units.displayText: We have more important matters at hand. We are still some distance away from the Pantheon. Do not let your guard down, Professor.

spans.text: We have more important matters at hand. We are still some distance away from the Pantheon. Do not let your guard down, Professor.

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: The tower shakes vigorously, interrupting the conversation. Angelus and Antonina scan the surroundings with heightened alert.
units.displayText: The tower shakes vigorously, interrupting the conversation. Angelus and Antonina scan the surroundings with heightened alert.

spans.text: The tower shakes vigorously, interrupting the conversation. Angelus and Antonina scan the surroundings with heightened alert.

units.rawText: Tch, has Eosphorus found us?
units.displayText: Tch, has Eosphorus found us?

spans.text: Tch, has Eosphorus found us?

units.rawText: ...No, that wasn't caused by an attack from the outside!
units.displayText: ...No, that wasn't caused by an attack from the outside!

spans.text: ...No, that wasn't caused by an attack from the outside!

units.rawText: It came from inside the tower!
units.displayText: It came from inside the tower!

spans.text: It came from inside the tower!

units.rawText: As if confirming Angelus' conjecture, the Entropics within the tower begin to frantically screech.
units.displayText: As if confirming Angelus' conjecture, the Entropics within the tower begin to frantically screech.

spans.text: As if confirming Angelus' conjecture, the Entropics within the tower begin to frantically screech.

units.rawText: High-intensity operand signal, from the upper layers, approaching fast! Approximately 30 seconds out from the layer we're on!
units.displayText: High-intensity operand signal, from the upper layers, approaching fast! Approximately 30 seconds out from the layer we're on!

spans.text: High-intensity operand signal, from the upper layers, approaching fast! Approximately 30 seconds out from the layer we're on!

units.rawText: Damn it! No way that's anyone or anything friendly...
units.displayText: Damn it! No way that's anyone or anything friendly...

spans.text: Damn it! No way that's anyone or anything friendly...

units.rawText: Can we identify which High Order Entropic it is? I'll figure out a strategy!
units.displayText: Can we identify which High Order Entropic it is? I'll figure out a strategy!

spans.text: Can we identify which High Order Entropic it is? I'll figure out a strategy!

units.rawText: I'm looking, hang on!
units.displayText: I'm looking, hang on!

spans.text: I'm looking, hang on!

units.rawText: Antonina quickly identifies the approaching signal. Her hand on the keyboard suddenly stops.
units.displayText: Antonina quickly identifies the approaching signal. Her hand on the keyboard suddenly stops.

spans.text: Antonina quickly identifies the approaching signal. Her hand on the keyboard suddenly stops.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: This ID looks familiar, it's...?!
units.displayText: This ID looks familiar, it's...?!

spans.text: This ID looks familiar, it's...?!

units.rawText: A dark silhouette leaps downwards, instantly shattering the ground beneath the group's feet.
units.displayText: A dark silhouette leaps downwards, instantly shattering the ground beneath the group's feet.

spans.text: A dark silhouette leaps downwards, instantly shattering the ground beneath the group's feet.

units.rawText: <color=purple>...</color>
Look out! Grab onto me, Professor, Antonina!
units.displayText: Look out! Grab onto me, Professor, Antonina!

spans.text: Look out! Grab onto me, Professor, Antonina!

units.rawText: Just as the two are about to fall, Angelus lifts them into the air, moving them away from the demolished area.
units.displayText: Just as the two are about to fall, Angelus lifts them into the air, moving them away from the demolished area.

spans.text: Just as the two are about to fall, Angelus lifts them into the air, moving them away from the demolished area.

units.rawText: The enemy moves to pursue, but Angelus forces them back with a few shots. It changes its angle of approaching, growling as it prepares to attack.
units.displayText: The enemy moves to pursue, but Angelus forces them back with a few shots. It changes its angle of approaching, growling as it prepares to attack.

spans.text: The enemy moves to pursue, but Angelus forces them back with a few shots. It changes its angle of approaching, growling as it prepares to attack.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Kyaak—!</color>
units.displayText: Kyaak—!

spans.text: Kyaak—!

units.rawText: That came out of nowhere... Antonina, prepare for combat.
units.displayText: That came out of nowhere... Antonina, prepare for combat.

spans.text: That came out of nowhere... Antonina, prepare for combat.

units.rawText: ...Antonina?
units.displayText: ...Antonina?

spans.text: ...Antonina?

units.rawText: ...Wisdom? Is that Wisdom?
units.displayText: ...Wisdom? Is that Wisdom?

spans.text: ...Wisdom? Is that Wisdom?

units.rawText: <color=purple>...</color>
We're partners now, right? Don't you worry, I'll keep you unharmed!
units.displayText: We're partners now, right? Don't you worry, I'll keep you unharmed!

spans.text: We're partners now, right? Don't you worry, I'll keep you unharmed!

units.rawText: You guys... are truly impressive! Especially the Professor's command...
units.displayText: You guys... are truly impressive! Especially the Professor's command...

spans.text: You guys... are truly impressive! Especially the Professor's command...

units.rawText: I will take her back to the Reverse Babylon Tower for healing.
units.displayText: I will take her back to the Reverse Babylon Tower for healing.

spans.text: I will take her back to the Reverse Babylon Tower for healing.

units.rawText: Pierides shall be under Sanctifier jurisdiction from now on. You ought to leave when you can.
units.displayText: Pierides shall be under Sanctifier jurisdiction from now on. You ought to leave when you can.

spans.text: Pierides shall be under Sanctifier jurisdiction from now on. You ought to leave when you can.

units.rawText: Why... are you here...
units.displayText: Why... are you here...

spans.text: Why... are you here...

units.rawText: Upon noticing their intensified Entropization, she puts two and two together. Anger immediately consumes her visage.
units.displayText: Upon noticing their intensified Entropization, she puts two and two together. Anger immediately consumes her visage.

spans.text: Upon noticing their intensified Entropization, she puts two and two together. Anger immediately consumes her visage.

units.rawText: Eosphorus... <size=60>YOU BASTARD!</size>
units.displayText: Eosphorus... YOU BASTARD!

spans.text: Eosphorus...
YOU BASTARD!

units.rawText: <color=purple>An... na...</color>
units.displayText: An... na...

spans.text: An... na...

units.rawText: <color=red><size=60>RAAARRRRGGHHHH!</size></color>
units.displayText: RAAARRRRGGHHHH!

spans.text: RAAARRRRGGHHHH!

units.rawText: The irate voice gradually distorts until it is no more than a twisted beast's howling.
units.displayText: The irate voice gradually distorts until it is no more than a twisted beast's howling.

spans.text: The irate voice gradually distorts until it is no more than a twisted beast's howling.

units.rawText: Wisdom...
units.displayText: Wisdom...

spans.text: Wisdom...

units.rawText: "We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night."
units.displayText: "We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night."

spans.text: "We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night."

units.rawText: Believe me, I am prepared to do whatever it takes, Lady Angelus!
units.displayText: Believe me, I am prepared to do whatever it takes, Lady Angelus!

spans.text: Believe me, I am prepared to do whatever it takes, Lady Angelus!

units.rawText: Past images flash through her neural cloud. Angelus opens her eyes after a deep breath, her eyes resolute.
units.displayText: Past images flash through her neural cloud. Angelus opens her eyes after a deep breath, her eyes resolute.

spans.text: Past images flash through her neural cloud. Angelus opens her eyes after a deep breath, her eyes resolute.

units.rawText: I respect your determination, Wisdom. I shall bring you release.
units.displayText: I respect your determination, Wisdom. I shall bring you release.

spans.text: I respect your determination, Wisdom. I shall bring you release.

units.rawText: Wisdom! You...
units.displayText: Wisdom! You...

spans.text: Wisdom! You...

units.rawText: Leave this to me.
units.displayText: Leave this to me.

spans.text: Leave this to me.

units.rawText: Angelus stops Antonina, shielding the two behind herself. She nocks an arrow of solidified operands.
units.displayText: Angelus stops Antonina, shielding the two behind herself. She nocks an arrow of solidified operands.

spans.text: Angelus stops Antonina, shielding the two behind herself. She nocks an arrow of solidified operands.

units.rawText: ...Damn it all!
units.displayText: ...Damn it all!

spans.text: ...Damn it all!

units.rawText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.
units.displayText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.

spans.text: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.

units.rawText: <color=red>Sleep well, Wisdom, with the honor of the Sanctifiers over you.</color>
units.displayText: Sleep well, Wisdom, with the honor of the Sanctifiers over you.

spans.text: Sleep well, Wisdom, with the honor of the Sanctifiers over you.
